title: Loop-Centric Engineering of Terminal Deoxynucleotidyl Transferase for Enhanced Catalysis of 3'-Modified Nucleotides.
authors: Shi, Kun; Li, An-Na; Xu, Jian-He; Yu, Hui-Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文结合深度学习结构预测与分子动力学模拟，对末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶进行环区工程改造，提升其对3'-修饰核苷酸的催化活性，属于蛋白质结构计算指导的酶工程研究，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Efficient enzymatic DNA synthesis requires terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferases (TdTs) that can accept reversibly blocked nucleotides, but improving wild-type enzymes has traditionally depended on labor-intensive screening. Here, we combine deep learning-based structure prediction with molecular dynamics simulations to guide loop-centric engineering of a TdT from Crocodylus porosus. The resulting variant M3 (V253E/L256M/N338R) showed a 26-fold increase in specific activity toward 3'-ONH(2)-dCTP while maintaining expression and thermostability. Simulations indicated that the mutations reorganized Loop1 dynamics and reproducibly biased the incoming nucleotide toward a more favorable in-line attack orientation. The key N338R change also improved a second TdT scaffold, supporting N338 as a potentially transferable engineering hotspot. These results provide a practical computational strategy for improving terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferases for incorporation of 3'-modified nucleotides, reducing reliance on large-scale screening.
abstract_zh: 高效的酶促DNA合成需要能够接受可逆封闭核苷酸的末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶（TdTs），但传统上改善野生型酶依赖于劳动密集型的筛选。在此，我们结合基于深度学习的结构预测与分子动力学模拟，以指导来自湾鳄（Crocodylus porosus）的TdT进行以环为中心的工程改造。所得变体M3（V253E/L256M/N338R）对3'-ONH(2)-dCTP的比活性提高了26倍，同时保持了表达和热稳定性。模拟表明，这些突变重排了Loop1的动态，并可重复地将进入的核苷酸偏向更有利的在线攻击取向。关键的N338R变化也改善了第二种TdT支架，支持N338作为潜在可转移的工程热点。这些结果为改进末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶以掺入3'-修饰核苷酸提供了一种实用的计算策略，减少了对大规模筛选的依赖。
